The '''Drukarg highlands''' was an area of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. This mountainous region featured sparse plant life and tall, natural pillar formations.

There was once an assassination attempt on [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] atop one of the pillars during a payment delivery from a [[Bosso Weex|spice runner]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] foiled the attempt.
